scope: Thirty source-backed combat-name bindings across 26 stable native form IDs. Twenty-four labels change; six already match. Numeric profiles, action categories and effects stay unchanged. Historical rules retain the previous labels.

categoryInterpretation.physical: Contact claw, limb or weapon damage. This is the existing Attack/Defense slot and Brace response; not an official damage-class claim.
categoryInterpretation.heavy: A committed charge, forceful piercing/crushing attack or weapon impact, adapted to the existing higher-cost Attack/Defense slot and Counter response. Heavy assignment is authored; source power adjectives do not set numeric damage.
categoryInterpretation.magic: Elemental energy, supernatural damage or an explicitly described special projectile, adapted to the existing Magic/Resistance slot and Ward response. Ordinary gunfire and ammunition are held separately; no automatic element/type changes.

sourcePolicy.primary: Official English Encyclopedia descriptions verify ownership and action semantics. Their prose and imagery are not imported; only short move names and authored paraphrases are retained.
sourcePolicy.fallback: Unmapped slots keep their existing authored names. A supported name may repeat across species with separate provenance. No generic move is relabeled solely because it appears in an upstream learnset.

held.name: Summon
held.reason: Elemental summoning is described; no direct damage attack is established.

held.name: Blue Blaster
held.reason: The official page names the move but gives no attack mechanism. Existing label may remain; this review does not infer its slot from the name.

held.name: Poison Ivy
held.reason: Its defining binding, poison and paralysis behavior is absent from the damage-only core.

held.name: Marching Fishes
held.reason: A commanded fish squad attacks; summon/swarm behavior is not represented by a supported slot.

held.name: Kohenkyo
held.reason: Appearance copying is a transformation effect, not damage.

held.name: Double Impact
held.reason: Twin shotgun fire is not magical energy; do not rename the Magic slot or silently add an ammunition class.

held.name: Giga Destroyer
held.reason: Bionic missile fire needs an explicit physical-ranged classification decision, not a name-only Magic binding.

held.name: Freezing Breath
held.reason: The description emphasizes freezing and immediate vital-function suspension; no freeze/incapacitation behavior is implemented.

held.name: Ice Wolf Claw
held.reason: Despite its name, this is a simultaneous weapon barrage, not a contact claw attack.

held.name: Electro Shocker
held.reason: Official ownership is listed, but the page does not describe the attack mechanism.

held.name: Giga Blaster
held.reason: The page calls it an upgraded Electro Shocker without describing delivery; do not derive a category solely from the name.

held.name: Heaven's Gate
held.reason: Banishment through a portal is not ordinary damage and would promise an absent mechanic.

held.name: Testament
held.reason: Its defining cost is self-sacrifice; the current skill slot does not implement that cost.

held.name: Thorn Whip
held.reason: The official description makes charm/control a defining result, which current damage slots cannot represent.

held.name: Fist of the Beast King
held.reason: The page does not describe delivery; the title alone cannot establish contact versus ranged force.

held.name: Harpoon Torpedo
held.reason: A fired regrowing horn is a physical projectile; hold until a deliberate ranged-physical slot policy exists.

integration.recommendation: Generate one constexpr formId/category override table for current native profiles and a matching host metadata projection. Keep immutable old profile strings for frozen care/practice engines; do not apply a browser-only overwrite to historic trace payloads.
integration.native: combat::formProfile supplies current Tactical, skill screen, roster and new Auto participant skill names. Epoch-scoped old practice profiles and frozen Auto traces retain their original labels.
integration.browserAuto: Replace generic autoStepText attack labels with the corresponding frozen trace.player.combat.skills for attack phase and trace.enemy.combat.skills for revealed opponent attacks during defend phase. Keep Physical/Heavy/Magic category visible and use token-only fallbacks for defenses/capture.
integration.migration: Any serialized combat-label change changes exact saved-response output even if damage is identical. Coordinate explicit care/practice label epoch and frozen replay before runtime activation.
requiredVerification: Every curated ID/category/name matches this table in native JSON, current Tactical and current Auto.
Frozen pre-change care and practice ACKs/traces stay byte-identical.
Damage, RNG, reward, type chart and numeric stat anchors are identical for label-only changes; test balance changes separately.
Source-supported long labels fit the nominal1.46in browser geometry without hiding the action category.
